summary: The diff implements Date.prototype.getSeconds in its own file. Steps 1-3 go through date::this_time_value(agent, this)?, which should cover RequireInternalSlot and the [[DateValue]] read. Step 4 returns NaN when tv is NaN. Step 5 returns Number(sec_from_time(local_time(agent, tv))). Each step keeps its spec comment, errors propagate with ?, and there are no special-cased inputs, hardcoded values or catch-all fallbacks. The only other change is renaming the unused args and new_target parameters to underscore-prefixed names, which is cosmetic and within the function. I could not read crate::support::date, so I am relying on the gate's build result and on the names of the helpers. The helper bodies, especially this_time_value's TypeError on non-Date receivers, are unverified.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found in the diff. Before merging, confirm that date::this_time_value throws a TypeError when the receiver is not an object or lacks [[DateValue]], and that date::sec_from_time and date::local_time match SecondFromTime and LocalTime. Those helpers live outside this diff and I did not review them.
